help.goal: Your team guesses where a secret point sits on a spectrum. The closer to the target, the more points.
steps: One player taps I'm the psychic 🔮 and sees the 🎯 target.
The psychic says one clue word out loud, nothing more.
The psychic taps Clue given ✓ and then stays silent.
The team talks it over and drags the dial slider.
Tap Lock it in 🔒 to score and reveal the target.
notes: The two ends of the spectrum are printed under the dial.
Closer is better: 4 points for a bullseye, then 3, then 2, then nothing.
Rounds alternate 🔴 and 🔵, so a new player takes the psychic seat.
